name: Fukyou no Hana - Snow Flower
source:
The main character, Takeru, who was living a comfortable life in the city working part-time as a designer, was forced to move deep into the snow-covered mountains.
Unable to adjust to the life deep in the mountains, complains every day about his desire to return to the city as soon as possible.
There, Takeru runs into his childhood friend, who works relentlessly to solve the problems plaguing the mountains.

[From [url=https://www.shinzoutranslations.com/2023/05/release-snow-flower-english.html]Shinzou Translations[/url]]
translation: 主角Takeru原本在城里过着舒适的生活，一边打工，一边从事设计工作，却被迫搬到积雪覆盖的深山里。他无法适应山中生活，每天都抱怨想尽快回到城里。某天，Takeru在那里遇见了自己的青梅竹马。她正不懈努力，解决困扰山里的种种问题。[引自[url=https://www.shinzoutranslations.com/2023/05/release-snow-flower-english.html]Shinzou Translations[/url]]
